whyMatters.heading: Why a Professional Post-Construction Clean is Essential
body: Construction dust is not ordinary household dust. Fine plaster, cement, and drywall particles are abrasive — damaging to surfaces, harmful when inhaled, and impossible to remove effectively without industrial-grade equipment. Attempting to clean a post-build property with a domestic vacuum simply redistributes the dust rather than removing it.

A professional builders clean from Cleaniq Services uses HEPA-filter industrial vacuums that capture particles down to 0.3 microns — ensuring that fine construction dust is fully removed rather than recirculated into the air. This protects both the occupants and the surfaces of your newly completed property.

For developers and contractors, a professional post-construction clean is also a contractual and reputational requirement. Properties handed over with visible dust, paint residue, or construction debris create a poor first impression and can result in snagging disputes. A professional handover clean from Cleaniq Services ensures your project is completed to the standard your clients expect.

tips.label: Tips
tips.h2: How to prepare for a post-construction clean
tips.intro: A little preparation helps our team clean faster and more thoroughly, and makes sure the property is ready on time:
tips: Book the clean once all trades have finished, including painters and decorators, so no new dust is created afterwards.
Ask your builder to clear large waste such as rubble, old fittings and offcuts before the clean.
Make sure the property has running water and electricity on the day.
Tell us about delicate new finishes, such as natural stone or high-gloss surfaces.
Let us know how our team can get in and where to park.
Keep windows open where possible during and after the work to help clear airborne dust.
Give yourself a buffer before your handover date in case anything needs a final touch.

faqs.q: What is included in a post-construction clean?
faqs.a: Our builders clean includes full dust removal from all surfaces using industrial HEPA vacuums, paint splash removal, protective film and sticker removal from fixtures and glazing, grout haze removal, and a full floor clean — leaving the property ready for occupation or handover.

faqs.q: How long does a post-construction clean take?
faqs.a: A typical one-bedroom flat takes 4–6 hours. Larger residential properties or commercial fit-outs are quoted individually following a site assessment. We work to your handover deadline.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial construction sites?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle post-build cleans for residential refurbishments, new-build developments, commercial office fit-outs, retail spaces, and industrial units across Greater Manchester.

faqs.q: Can you remove paint from floors and surfaces?
faqs.a: Yes. We use specialist products to remove paint splashes, sealant residue, and adhesive from hard floors, tiles, glass, and fixtures without causing surface damage.

faqs.q: What Manchester areas do you cover for post-construction cleaning?
faqs.a: We cover all of Greater Manchester including City Centre, Salford, Didsbury, Stockport, Trafford, Wythenshawe, Ancoats, and surrounding postcodes.

faqs.q: How much does post-construction cleaning cost in Manchester?
faqs.a: It depends on the size and condition of the property and what work was done. Larger properties and commercial fit-outs are quoted individually after a site assessment. Call us or use our quote form for a quote.

faqs.q: When should I book a post-construction clean?
faqs.a: Once all trades have finished, including painters and decorators, so no new dust is created after the clean. We'll plan the date around your handover.
We remove site debris from the immediate access areas as part of the clean. Large waste such as rubble, skips and old fittings should be cleared by your builder first.

faqs.q: Can you clean a new-build home before we move in?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean new-build homes and developments, removing construction dust, stickers and protective film so the property is ready to move into.

faqs.q: Is a post-construction clean the same as a deep clean?
faqs.a: No. A post-construction clean is designed for properties after building work, removing fine construction dust, paint splashes and protective film. A deep clean is for lived-in homes that need a top-to-bottom refresh.
